definitions.explanation: A marker set up on a grave to show who lies there: a wooden post, a cross or a stone. Somewhat literary.

examples.japanese: {墓標|ぼひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: To put up a grave marker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{墓標|ぼひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: White grave markers stand in rows on the hill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{刻|きざ}まれていない→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{墓標|ぼひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いくつ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: On the old battlefield, many wooden grave markers without even a name on them still stood.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {墓石|はかいし}: gravestone, the stone of a Japanese family grave
- ⟦{墓|はか}→墓：03549_haka⟧: the grave itself
- {卒塔婆|そとば}: the tall wooden memorial tablets set behind Japanese graves
{墓標|ぼひょう} is the general word for whatever marks a grave, and suits a single cross or post better than {墓石|はかいし}.
